title: knowgov MCP result _meta
description: task-0365, decision-0048: the knowgov fields of a tools/call result's _meta (harness/result_marks.py). io.knowgov/clipped is present only when the answer holds less than the tool read: register_nodes past its limit, scenario_runs past its limit, or an answer refused over KG_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE (what bytes, returned 0). io.knowgov/large is present only when the answer's text is over KG_MCP_CLIENT_BUDGET characters: it is whole, but a client may cut it. An answer with neither is the result it was before. Each mark is also a text item, in words, before the answer, which stays the last text item. The 2026-07-28 era's io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo sits beside them.

what.description: what returned and total count: register nodes, runs, or the refused answer's bytes

total.description: how many the tool holds for the call

narrower.description: the call that reads the rest, or reads less

partial.description: nothing is cut: the answer is whole (task-0177)

chars.description: the characters of the answer's text item

budget.description: KG_MCP_CLIENT_BUDGET as this server read it

count.description: what the answer holds, by tool (findings, statements, keys, nodes, outputs, runs); null for a tool with no count
